रिभ् रिभ् or रेभ्, cl. 1. A. रेभते (Ved.
also P. रेभति), रिरेभे, रेभितुम्, to
crackle, creak; to murmur (as a stream &c.); to
sound in general; to chatter, babble, clatter; to talk
or speak aloud, shout with joy, rejoice [cf. rt. रिह्];
to praise, glorify, worship (Ved. P.): Pass. रिभ्यते,
to be praised or glorified; [cf. Gr. ῥοίβδην, ῥοῖβδος,
ῥοιβδέω.]
रिभ्वन्, आ, m., Ved. (according to Naigh.
